title: URGENT REVISION: CS402 Final Examination Schedule
inputText:
CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS -- EMERGENCY NOTIFICATION
Ref: COE/2026/F-402
Date: 2026-10-25

Attention: Students enrolled in CS402 Computer Networks.

Due to the Annual University Convocation ceremony being held on December 08, 2026, the CS402 Comprehensive Theory Final Examination has been RESCHEDULED to an earlier date.

Revised Exam Schedule:
- Date: 2026-12-01
- Time: 14:00 - 17:00
- Venue: Examination Hall C

The previously announced date of 2026-12-08 stands CANCELLED. All students must appear on December 01, 2026.
